title: Lazy load Slack SDK
body:
Resubmission of #66028 with fixes to tests.

Sorry about the previous PR; was just totally slammed the last few months between my job and moving to a new city. Much easier to work on OSS with a 3-day weekend. 😄

---

Lazy-load `slack_sdk` imports to reduce memory footprint of both importing the Slack hooks and also usage (since some of the memory footprint is specific to the async SDK, which isn't always used even during execution contexts).

* closes: #66025
